title: Longest Continuous Subarray With Absolute Diff Less Than or Equal to Limit
summary: Given an array of integers and a limit, find the length of the longest continuous subarray where the absolute difference between any two elements does not exceed the limit.
statement: Given an array of integers and a limit, find the length of the longest continuous subarray where the absolute difference between any two elements does not exceed the limit.
constraints: Find the longest contiguous subarray whose maximum minus minimum is at most limit.
hints: Maintain increasing indices for the minimum and decreasing indices for the maximum.
Their fronts give the current window extrema.
While the range exceeds limit, advance left and remove expired front indices.
After repair, the window is the longest valid one ending at right.
editorial: After repair, the window is the longest valid one ending at right.

tests.explanation: The longest valid windows [2,4] and [4,7] have length two.
The window [2,4,7,2] has length four and range five.
